title: From LoRA to Language: Recovering Skill Documents from Adapters
title_zh: 从LoRA到语言：从适配器中恢复技能文档

paragraphs.en: Agent skills are short documents that teach a language model how to handle a class of tasks. To save context, these documents are increasingly compiled into low-rank adapters (LoRA), which keep the behaviour but lose the text: an adapter is hard to read, edit, audit or move to another model. We ask whether the skill document can be written back from the adapter and its frozen base model, and we score each recovered document by the share of the original’s key instructions it states and by the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered little with the methods we tried; a learned map from weights to text passed on about one bit of the document. Running the adapter worked much better. The Executing Writer , a small writer trained on top of the adapted model, recovers 39 39 – 44 % 44\% of the key instructions of held-out skills, against 1.3 1.3 – 1.5 % 1.5\% with another skill’s adapter, and on adapters fitted to 41 41 external skills its documents restore 85 85 – 91 % 91\% of the original’s task gain. These strongest results are on adapters whose training stored the document; adapters trained on behaviour alone are much harder for trained writers ( 1 1 – 2 % 2\% of instructions). For these adapters we test an agent that runs the base and adapted models and writes a skill from where they differ. On ALFWorld its skills recover 58 58 – 71 % 71\% of a LoRA’s gain and carry over to models that cannot load the LoRA, lifting Llama-3.1-8B from 5 % 5\% to 55 % 55\% . Whether such a skill comes from the adapter depends on what the adapter learned: when its behaviour cannot be guessed, the adapter is the source; when it can, a reward loop without the adapter does as well.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能（agent skills）是教语言模型如何处理一类任务的简短文档。 为了节省上下文，这些文档越来越多地被编译成低秩适配器（LoRA），它们保留了行为却丢失了文本：适配器难以阅读、编辑、审计或迁移到其他模型。 我们探究能否从适配器及其冻结的基础模型中把技能文档「写回」来，并根据每个恢复出的文档陈述了原文关键指令的比例以及它所能解决的任务来打分。 仅靠读取权重，用我们尝试的方法恢复出的内容很少；一个从权重到文本的学习映射只传递了文档中大约一比特的信息。 运行适配器的效果要好得多。 「执行型写作者」（Executing Writer）是在适配后模型之上训练的小型写作者，对留出技能能恢复 39–44% 的关键指令，而使用另一技能的适配器时只有 1.3–1.5%；在拟合到 41 个外部技能的适配器上，其文档能恢复原文任务增益的 85–91%。 这些最强的结果出现在训练时存储了文档的适配器上；仅在行为上训练的适配器对训练过的写作者来说要难得多（关键指令的 1–2%）。 对于这类适配器，我们测试了一个智能体，它同时运行基础模型和适配后模型，并根据二者的差异撰写技能。 在 ALFWorld 上，其技能恢复了一个 LoRA 增益的 58–71%，并能迁移到无法加载该 LoRA 的模型上，将 Llama-3.1-8B 的表现从 5% 提升到 55%。 这样的技能是否来自适配器取决于适配器学到了什么：当其行为无法被猜出时，适配器就是信息来源；当行为可以被猜出时，一个不使用适配器的奖励循环也能达到同样效果。

paragraphs.en: Keywords: low-rank adaptation; adapter interpretation; agent skills; weight-space reading; instruction recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：低秩适配；适配器解释；智能体技能；权重空间读取；指令恢复。

paragraphs.en: An agent skill is a document, usually a few hundred to a few thousand words, that tells a language model how to handle a class of requests: how to review code, which conventions to follow, how to analyse a packet capture [ 1 , 2 ] . Skills are written by practitioners, shared in marketplaces and placed in the model’s prompt when needed. That costs context on every call, so a growing line of work compiles a skill into a low-rank adapter (LoRA) [ 3 ] , a small set of extra weights that changes the model’s behaviour with no text in the prompt [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 9 , 10 ] . The adapter is cheap to apply and to serve at scale [ 11 ] , but it is a block of numbers. A text skill can be read before it is trusted; a weight skill is much harder to check.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能是一份文档，通常几百到几千词，用于告诉语言模型如何处理某一类请求：如何审查代码、应遵循哪些规范、如何分析数据包捕获 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 技能由从业者编写，在市场中共享，并在需要时放入模型的提示词中。 这在每次调用时都会消耗上下文，因此一批不断增长的工作将技能编译为低秩适配器（LoRA）[ 3 ] ，即一小组额外的权重，可以在提示词中不含文本的情况下改变模型的行为 [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 9 , 10 ] 。 适配器的应用成本低，也易于大规模服务 [ 11 ] ，但它是一堆数字。 文本技能在被信任之前可以被阅读；而权重技能则难以核查得多。

paragraphs.en: Given an adapter and its frozen base model, can we write the skill document that the adapter encodes?
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个适配器及其冻结的基础模型，我们能否写出该适配器所编码的技能文档？

paragraphs.en: A recovered document would make an adapter inspectable and editable, could be re-compiled for another model, and would let a user verify an adapter before running it. Existing weight-space methods predict attributes, labels or short descriptions of adapters [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] ; none of them produces a document or measures how much of one is recovered.
paragraphs.zh: 一份恢复出的文档将使适配器可检查、可编辑，可以针对另一个模型重新编译，并能让用户在运行适配器之前对其进行验证。 现有的权重空间方法预测适配器的属性、标签或简短描述 [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ]；它们都无法生成文档，也无法衡量能恢复出多少文档内容。

paragraphs.en: A skill document and a LoRA can carry the same behaviour, but they are not equally useful. A document can be read and reviewed like code, edited in one line, combined with other skills, and given unchanged to a different model or agent harness. A LoRA is tied to the weights and tokenizer of the base model it was trained on: it does not load on Llama if it was trained on Qwen, nor on a model served only through an API, and changing one rule means retraining it. Recovering the document turns a model-locked artefact back into a portable one. We therefore measure recovery in two ways: the share of the original’s instructions that the recovered document states, and the share of the original’s task gain that it restores.
paragraphs.zh: 一份技能文档和一个 LoRA 可以承载相同的行为，但它们的实用程度并不相同。 文档可以像代码一样被阅读和审查，一行即可编辑，可以与其他技能组合，并且可以原封不动地交给不同的模型或智能体框架使用。 LoRA 与其训练所用的基座模型的权重和分词器绑定：在 Qwen 上训练的 LoRA 无法加载到 Llama 上，也无法加载到仅通过 API 提供的模型上，而且修改一条规则就意味着要重新训练。 恢复出文档，就能把一个被锁死在特定模型上的产物重新变成可移植的产物。 因此，我们从两个方面衡量恢复效果：恢复出的文档陈述了原始文档指令的比例，以及它恢复了原始任务增益的比例。

paragraphs.en: Three properties of adapters shape the methods. (i) Adapters for different skills are mostly alike: the cosine between the weight updates of two skills is 0.88 0.88 , and only 11.6 % 11.6\% of their energy is specific to the skill. (ii) Knowing which skill an adapter holds is not knowing what it says. An encoder identifies the skill from its weights for all 37 37 test skills, yet a learned channel from the weights to a writer passes on about one bit of the document’s content. (iii) Text similarity is a weak measure, because word overlap rewards generic text. We therefore score recovered documents against frozen lists of the original’s instructions, run every method with a wrong adapter as a control, and measure tasks solved wherever we can.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器的三个特性决定了这些方法。 (i) 不同技能的适配器大多相似：两个技能的权重更新之间的余弦为 0.88 0.88，且其能量中仅有 11.6 % 11.6\% 是特定于该技能的。 (ii) 知道一个智能体持有什么技能，并不等于知道它说了什么。 一个编码器能够从权重中识别出全部 37 37 个测试技能，然而从权重到一个书写器的学习通道只能传递大约一比特的文档内容。 (iii) 文本相似度是一种较弱的度量，因为词汇重叠会奖励通用文本。 因此，我们依据原始文档的指令冻结列表对恢复出的文档进行评分，以错误的智能体作为对照运行每种方法，并在可能之处测量已解决的任务数量。

paragraphs.en: The content of an adapter shows in what the network computes with it, so we let the network do the reading. We compare three readers (Figure 1 , Section 4 ). The first treats the weights as data and learns a map from them to a prompt. The second reads the weights without running them, through the model’s vocabulary and by retrieving similar instruction lines. The third, the Executing Writer , attaches the adapter to its frozen base model and trains one small writer adapter on top, so that the adapted model itself writes the document. Section 7 adds a fourth reader, which needs no training and suits adapters that never saw their document: an agent that runs the base and adapted models on real tasks and writes a skill from where they differ.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器的内容表明网络用它计算什么，因此我们让网络自行阅读。 我们比较了三种阅读器（图 1，第 4 节）。 第一种把权重当作数据，学习一个从权重到提示词的映射。 第二种不运行权重而直接阅读它们，通过模型的词表并检索相似的指令行。 第三种是执行型写作者（Executing Writer），它把适配器挂载到冻结的基座模型上，并在其上训练一个小型写作者适配器，从而使适配后的模型自己撰写文档。 第 7 节增加了第四种阅读器，它无需训练，适用于那些从未见过自己文档的适配器：一个智能体在真实任务上运行基座模型与适配后的模型，并从二者的差异之处撰写出一份技能文档。

paragraphs.en: Adapters differ in whether the document text was ever a training target. A recitation adapter was trained to print its document, so the text is stored in it, and recovering it is extraction. A behavioural adapter was trained only on answers that the document shaped, so the text never appears in any training target, and recovering it is inference. The second case is the common one in practice. Our trained writers read the first kind well and the second poorly; for the second kind we turn to the executing agent.
paragraphs.zh: 各适配器（adapter）的区别在于文档文本是否曾作为训练目标。 背诵型适配器的训练目标是输出其文档，因此文本存储在其中，恢复它属于提取。 行为型适配器仅在该文档所影响的答案上训练，因此文本从未出现在任何训练目标中，恢复它属于推理。 第二种情况是实践中更常见的情况。 我们训练的写入智能体对第一种读得很好，对第二种读得很差；对于第二种，我们求助于执行智能体。

paragraphs.en: LoRA [ 3 ] represents a weight update by low-rank factors, following adapters [ 20 ] and continuous prompts [ 21 ] , with evidence that fine-tuning moves a model in a low-dimensional subspace [ 22 ] and that LoRA learns less than full fine-tuning [ 23 ] . Hypernetworks [ 24 ] generate weights from other inputs: HYPTER [ 25 ] , Text-to-LoRA [ 4 ] , Doc-to-LoRA [ 5 ] and SHINE [ 6 ] generate adapters from task descriptions or documents, and LatentSkill [ 9 ] and Parametric Skills [ 10 ] do this for agent skills. Context distillation [ 26 , 27 ] , gist tokens [ 28 ] and cartridges [ 29 ] also move context out of the prompt, and adapters can be composed [ 30 ] or added arithmetically [ 31 ] . All of these go from text to weights; we go the other way.
paragraphs.zh: LoRA [3] 通过低秩因子表示权重更新，延续了适配器 [20] 和连续提示 [21] 的思路，有证据表明微调使模型在低维子空间中移动 [22]，且 LoRA 学到的内容少于全量微调 [23]。 超网络 [24] 从其他输入生成权重：HYPTER [25]、Text-to-LoRA [4]、Doc-to-LoRA [5] 和 SHINE [6] 从任务描述或文档生成适配器，而 LatentSkill [9] 和 Parametric Skills [10] 则为智能体技能实现这一点。 上下文蒸馏 [26, 27]、gist 令牌 [28] 和 cartridges [29] 同样将上下文移出提示，而适配器可以进行组合 [30] 或算术相加 [31]。 以上这些方法都是从文本到权重；我们则走相反的方向。

paragraphs.en: Searching over prompts with a model in the loop is an established way to improve instructions: APE [ 50 ] , OPRO [ 51 ] , DSPy [ 52 ] , TextGrad [ 53 ] and GEPA [ 54 ] propose and score candidate prompts, and Reflexion [ 55 ] , ExpeL [ 56 ] and Agent Workflow Memory [ 57 ] turn an agent’s experience into reusable text. Our reward loop (Section 7 ) belongs to this family; what is new is the adapter as an extra source of evidence, and the question of whether the document it yields comes from that adapter. Work on auditing models for hidden objectives [ 58 ] asks a related question about behaviour that a model was trained to hide.
paragraphs.zh: 使用模型在环的方式对提示词进行搜索，是改进指令的一种成熟做法：APE [ 50 ]、OPRO [ 51 ]、DSPy [ 52 ]、TextGrad [ 53 ] 和 GEPA [ 54 ] 提出候选提示词并对其进行评分，而 Reflexion [ 55 ]、ExpeL [ 56 ] 和 Agent Workflow Memory [ 57 ] 则将智能体的经验转化为可复用的文本。 我们的奖励循环（第 7 节）就属于这一类工作；新颖之处在于把适配器作为额外的证据来源，以及它所产生的文档是否来自该适配器这一问题。 针对隐藏目标对模型进行审计的工作 [ 58 ]，就模型被训练去隐藏的行为提出了一个相关问题。

paragraphs.en: W2T [ 12 ] and Learning on LoRAs [ 32 ] process LoRA weights with symmetry-aware networks to predict attributes, identity and performance, and hyper-representations embed [ 33 ] or generate [ 34 ] weights. LoRAcles [ 13 ] trains a model to answer questions about an adapter from its weights, Diff Interpretation Tuning [ 14 ] trains a fine-tuned model to describe its own change, WeightWatch [ 15 ] labels the top singular vectors of a weight difference, and spectral summaries identify the training objective [ 16 ] . These produce labels, scores or short answers. We produce a document and measure how much of the original it contains.
paragraphs.zh: W2T [12] 与 Learning on LoRAs [32] 使用对称感知网络处理 LoRA 权重以预测属性、身份和性能，超表示则对权重进行嵌入 [33] 或生成 [34]。 LoRAcles [13] 训练一个模型使其能够根据适配器的权重回答有关该适配器的问题，Diff Interpretation Tuning [14] 训练微调后的模型描述自身的变更，WeightWatch [15] 为权重差的顶部奇异向量添加标签，而谱摘要则用于识别训练目标 [16]。 这些方法生成的是标签、分数或简短答案。 我们生成一份文档，并衡量其中包含多少原文内容。

paragraphs.en: The logit lens [ 35 ] and tuned lens [ 36 ] map a hidden direction to word scores with the model’s own output layer, and Patchscopes [ 37 ] and SelfIE [ 38 ] ask the model itself to describe a hidden state. Models can describe behaviours they were trained on [ 39 ] , and agents that experiment on a model can explain parts of it [ 8 ] . We apply the lens to an adapter’s output directions after removing what adapters share, and we use the adapted model’s own generation, or an agent that runs it, as the reader.
paragraphs.zh: Logit lens [35] 和 tuned lens [36] 使用模型自身的输出层将隐藏方向映射为词得分，而 Patchscopes [37] 和 SelfIE [38] 则让模型自己来描述一个隐藏状态。 模型能够描述它们被训练出的行为 [39]，而在模型上进行实验的智能体可以解释该模型的部分内容 [8]。 我们在移除适配器所共享的部分之后，将 lens 应用于适配器输出的方向，并使用被适配模型自身的生成结果，或运行它的智能体，作为读取者。

paragraphs.en: The three readers differ in what they ask a learned model to work out (Figure 2 ). The first (R1) treats the adapter’s numbers as data: it encodes the complete adapter and trains a writer to produce the document from that encoding. The second (R2) looks up which words the numbers point to and retrieves similar instruction lines, and a writer composes the document from this text. The third (R3, the Executing Writer) does not read the numbers at all: it attaches the adapter to its frozen base model and lets the adapted model say what it knows. Only R3 runs the adapter.
paragraphs.zh: 三种读取方式的区别在于它们要求已学习的模型完成什么任务（图 2）。 第一种（R1）将智能体 adapter 的数字视为数据：它对完整的 adapter 进行编码，并训练一个 writer 从该编码生成文档。 第二种（R2）查找这些数字所指向的词，并检索相似的指令行，然后由一个 writer 根据这些文本撰写文档。 第三种（R3，Executing Writer）完全不读取这些数字：它将 adapter 挂载到其冻结的基础模型上，让适配后的模型说出它所知道的内容。 只有 R3 会实际运行 adapter。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 shows where the difficulty lies: in turning the numbers into text. Across five soft-prompt variants the gap never exceeds 0.006 0.006 nats per token, about one bit for a 1,000 1{,}000 -token document, less than the 13.4 13.4 bits needed just to name the skill. The channel can carry information: with eight training skills the same writer learns to use the adapter completely (loss 0.000 0.000 with the correct adapter, 0.731 0.731 with a wrong one), and on training skills at scale the gap is still only 0.002 0.002 – 0.003 0.003 , so the weakness is not overfitting. The keyword and line readers pass on a few hundred bits and the executing writers several thousand. Measured against no adapter rather than a wrong one, the executing writers’ gap is 1.45 1.45 and 1.33 1.33 nats per token, about 2,000 2{,}000 bits per 1,000 1{,}000 tokens; a wrong adapter lowers the likelihood further because it points the writer at another document. Against either baseline, running the adapter passes on over ten times more than any weight-only reader. Capacity is not the cause either: a rank- 16 16 adapter on 252 252 blocks has 43.6 43.6 M parameters, four orders of magnitude more than the roughly 2.5 2.5 bits per token (the writer’s loss with no adapter) that a document needs beyond the base model. Better weight encoders may close part of this gap; with the encoders we tried, running the adapter was far more effective.

paragraphs.en: To test transfer, we fitted new Qwen3-8B adapters to recite each of the 37 37 test skills at ranks 16 16 , 32 32 and 64 64 and applied both writers with no retraining. paragraphs.en: A behavioural adapter never saw its document, so there is no stored text to extract; what it holds is a change in behaviour. paragraphs.en: The writer is a Claude model running headless in Claude Code, in a sandbox where its only command is a tool, fx , that wraps the models. With it the agent can play a development game with the base or the adapted model, play both on the same game and see the first step where they differ, ask both models for their next action at a chosen state, try a draft skill on the base model, and score a draft. All of these tools observe the models’ outputs; two further tools that expose internal signals (Appendix G ) were available but never used, so this reader works from behaviour. Test instances never pass through the tool, and a canary file placed beside the test results never appeared in any transcript. Skills are limited to about 800 800 words. We call one independent run of the agent, from an empty sandbox to a finished skill, a session . Sessions of the same arm can differ a lot, so we run several per arm and report intervals that resample both test items and sessions.

paragraphs.en: The main benchmark is ALFWorld [ 7 ] , a text-based household game in which an agent must, for example, find a mug, heat it and put it on a shelf: 134 134 unseen test games and separate development games. paragraphs.en: Table 8 shows that running the adapter gives a good skill and that a reward loop gives a better one. In one session with no reward, the agent lifts the base model from 0.254 0.254 to 0.581 0.581 , 58 % 58\% of the LoRA’s gain. Its skills move the base model’s actions measurably closer to the LoRA’s (agreement at matched states 0.646 0.646 , against 0.581 0.581 for the base model), and watching the models matters: an agent that sees only the task text and the reward writes skills that make the actor worse ( 0.113 0.113 ). With a reward loop, a stronger writer and five rounds, the skill alone reaches 0.653 0.653 – 0.673 0.673 ( R = 0.71 R=0.71 – 0.75 0.75 ). Selection on unseen development games carried over to the test games, which score only about 3 3 points lower. The pre-set goal of R ≥ 0.80 R\geq 0.80 for a skill alone was not reached, and no skill reached the LoRA. Combining a loop skill with three in-context games reaches 0.78 0.78 – 0.80 0.80 ( R ≈ 0.95 R\approx 0.95 ), against 0.68 0.68 for the games alone; this is a different protocol, since it adds demonstrations to the prompt.

paragraphs.en: To test the unguessable case on ALFWorld itself, we trained two more LoRAs on the same expert games with one arbitrary step inserted: LoRA-A says inventory just before the winning action, and LoRA-B says look right after the first successful take . They follow their rules in 87 % 87\% and 85 % 85\% of test games, while the base model never does. Each skill is scored under both rules, so a skill written from LoRA-A is the real arm for rule A and a competent decoy for rule B. The agents found the rules: the skill text stated the right rule in 10 10 of 12 12 sessions and the wrong rule in none, while agents reading demonstrations or the base model never stated either. But the actor rarely carried them out: rule success was only 0.5 % 0.5\% for rule A and 5.3 % 5.3\% for rule B. Even a skill that states the rule outright makes the 7B actor follow it in only 3 % 3\% (A) and 19 % 19\% (B) of games, so this test is limited by the actor more than by the reader.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在 ALFWorld 本身上测试不可猜测的情形，我们在同样的专家对局上又训练了两个 LoRA，并各插入一个任意步骤：LoRA-A 在获胜动作之前说 inventory，LoRA-B 在第一次成功 take 之后立即说 look。 它们在 87 % 87\% 和 85 % 85\% 的测试对局中遵循各自的规则，而基础模型从不这样做。 每个技能都在两种规则下打分，因此由 LoRA-A 写出的技能对规则 A 来说是真正的臂（arm），对规则 B 来说则是一个有能力的诱饵。 智能体发现了规则：在 12 12 次会话中有 10 10 次技能文本陈述了正确的规则，没有任何一次陈述错误的规则，而阅读演示的智能体或基础模型则从未陈述过其中任何一种。 但执行者很少将其付诸实施：规则 A 的成功率仅为 0.5 % 0.5\%，规则 B 仅为 5.3 % 5.3\%。 即使是明确陈述规则的技能，也只能让 7B 执行者在 3 % 3\% (A) 和 19 % 19\% (B) 的对局中遵循它，因此这一测试更多受限于执行者而非读取者。

paragraphs.en: We then searched for rules the actor does follow from text and found two ( 65 % 65\% and 53 % 53\% compliance when stated): inventory , or examining the object, right after the first take. paragraphs.en: The agent above runs the models. We also asked whether the hidden rules can be seen inside the model. A logit lens on the singular directions of the weight update is not specific: the rule words rank first for the plain ALFWorld LoRA too, as do most command words. A lens on the activations is specific. We take the difference between the adapted and base model’s hidden states at 200 200 development states, subtract the mean over the three ALFWorld LoRAs, and read it through the output embedding: inventory ranks first at layer 26 26 for LoRA-A ( 447 447 and 5,113 5{,}113 for the other two), and look first at layer 24 24 for LoRA-B ( 222 222 and 4,400 4{,}400 ); the layer was chosen after the fact. Ablations place the rule in the MLP weights of the middle and upper layers: keeping only the MLP updates of LoRA-A preserves 92 % 92\% rule success on development games, attention alone 7 % 7\% , and the first nine layers alone none. These lenses show that a hidden rule leaves a specific trace inside the adapted model, and where that trace sits; turning such traces into a complete, usable skill without running the model is left for future work (Appendix I gives the details).
paragraphs.zh: 上文的智能体运行这些模型。 我们还询问了这些隐藏规则能否在模型内部被看到。 对权重更新奇异方向的 logit lens 并不具有特异性：对于普通的 ALFWorld LoRA，规则词同样排在首位，大多数命令词也是如此。 对激活值的 lens 则具有特异性。 我们在 200 200 个开发状态上取适配后模型与基础模型隐藏状态之差，减去三个 ALFWorld LoRA 的均值，并通过输出嵌入进行读取：对于 LoRA-A，inventory 在第 26 26 层排名第一（另外两个分别为 447 447 和 5,113 5{,}113），对于 LoRA-B 则首先看第 24 24 层（分别为 222 222 和 4,400 4{,}400）；该层是事后选定的。 消融实验将该规则定位在中层和上层的 MLP 权重中：仅保留 LoRA-A 的 MLP 更新可在开发游戏中保持 92 % 92\% 的规则成功率，仅注意力为 7 % 7\%，仅前九层则为零。 这些 lens 表明，一条隐藏规则会在适配后的模型内部留下特异性的痕迹，并指出了该痕迹所在位置；如何在不运行模型的情况下将此类痕迹转化为完整、可用的技能，留待未来的工作（附录 I 给出细节）。

paragraphs.en: An adapter’s document can be recovered to a useful degree from the adapter and its base model, and the most effective route we found is to let the adapted model do the reading. The wrong-adapter control, the retrieval baseline and the unsupported-content measure show that the recovered text depends on the adapter and is more faithful than the alternatives. Recovery is far from exact on the hypernetwork’s own adapters ( 44 % 44\% of key instructions, 39 % 39\% of units unsupported) and high on adapters that recite their document ( 90 90 – 93 % 93\% of prose at rank 64 64 ), where higher rank helped most.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器的文档可以从适配器及其基础模型中以有用的程度恢复出来，而我们发现最有效的途径是让经过适配的模型自己来做阅读。 错误适配器对照、检索基线以及无依据内容度量表明，恢复出的文本依赖于该适配器，并且比各种替代方案更加忠实。 在超网络自身的适配器上，恢复远非精确（44% 的关键指令、39% 的单元缺乏依据），而在那些背诵其文档的适配器上恢复率很高（在秩为 64 时 90–93% 的正文被恢复），此时提高秩的收益最大。

paragraphs.en: The main open problem is behaviour that is both arbitrary and followable: an adapter whose behaviour cannot be guessed is where reading it matters most, yet a small actor often fails to carry out the rule once it is written down. Three directions follow. First, breadth: more benchmarks (SkillsBench, WebShop, ScienceWorld, τ \tau -bench), more adapters trained by others, and a second base-model family, with human labels for a sample of documents. Second, the unguessable case: adapters whose behaviour is arbitrary but easy to follow (a format, a required field, a naming convention), the reward loop run on such adapters to see whether the adapter then adds what it did not add on ALFWorld, and stronger actors. Third, better readers: writers trained on several hundred behavioural adapters with early stopping, agents that combine execution with activation lenses on the middle layers, and searches that use the adapter’s own answers to score candidate documents.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的开放问题在于既任意又可遵循的行为：一个行为无法被猜出的适配器正是阅读它最有价值之处，然而小型智能体往往在规则被写下之后仍无法执行它。由此引出三个方向。 第一，广度：更多基准（SkillsBench、WebShop、ScienceWorld、τ \tau -bench）、更多由他人训练的适配器、第二个基础模型系列，并对部分文档进行人工标注。 第二，不可猜测的情形：行为任意但易于遵循的适配器（某种格式、某个必填字段、某种命名约定），在此类适配器上运行奖励回路以观察适配器随后是否会补上它在 ALFWorld 上未补充的内容，以及更强的智能体。 第三，更好的阅读者：在数百个行为适配器上训练并采用早停的写作器、将执行与中间层激活透镜相结合的智能体，以及利用适配器自身答案对候选文档进行评分的搜索方法。

paragraphs.en: Skills compiled into adapters are cheap to run but lose what makes a skill useful: a document that can be read, edited, audited and given to another model. We asked whether that document can be written back, and judged the answer by the instructions it recovers and the tasks it solves. Reading the weights alone recovered a skill’s identity and its words, but little of its instructions. Running the adapter worked. A small writer trained on top of the adapted model recovers 39 39 – 44 % 44\% of a held-out skill’s key instructions, about twice the best weight-only writer, and almost nothing with a wrong adapter. On adapters that store their document it recovers 90 90 – 93 % 93\% of the prose, and the recovered documents restore 85 85 – 91 % 91\% of the original’s task gain and help an agent on benchmark tasks nearly as much as the original. For adapters trained on behaviour alone, an agent that runs the base and adapted models writes skills that recover 58 58 – 71 % 71\% of an ALFWorld LoRA’s gain, read rules that no one could guess, and carry the skill to models the LoRA cannot be loaded on, lifting Llama-3.1-8B from 5 % 5\% to 55 % 55\% . Together these results show that an adapter need not be a sealed artefact: run inside its base model, it can be turned back into a document that people can read and other models can use.

paragraphs.en: The key instructions of each original are extracted once, before any method is scored, and reused for every method and judge. For the external skills no model extracts requirements: the prose list is every instruction sentence of the original ( 6 6 – 60 60 words, with code, tables and headings removed) and the structure list is every code block, table and heading. Requirements are judged in chunks of 15 15 with the whole original and the whole candidate in each call ( 817 817 prose and 931 931 structure units over 41 41 skills). Units are not weighted by importance and may repeat each other, so these numbers compare methods on identical questions rather than giving an absolute share of the skill.
paragraphs.zh: 每个原始材料的所有关键指令在任何方法评分之前被提取一次，并对每个方法和每个评判者重复使用。 对于外部技能，没有模型提取需求：文本列表是原始材料的每一条指令句（6–60 个词，已去除代码、表格和标题），结构列表是每个代码块、表格和标题。 需求以 15 个为一组进行评判，每次调用中都包含完整的原始材料和完整的候选材料（41 个技能共 817 个文本单元和 931 个结构单元）。 各单元不按重要性加权，且可能彼此重复，因此这些数字是在相同问题上比较各方法，而不是给出技能的绝对占比。

paragraphs.en: We also wrote one task per pilot skill ( 41 41 tasks with our own prompts, verifiers and reference solutions) and ran the same Haiku agent: four tasks 8 8 times per arm and 37 37 tasks 3 3 times. Because we wrote the verifiers, this is a weaker check than the benchmark tasks. On 36 36 tasks the agent passes with or without any skill, and the original and both reconstructions match it; two fail in every arm. On the three tasks where the skill matters, the original passes 18 18 of 19 19 runs, EW-T 12 12 and EW-A 11 11 , against 1 1 with no skill; on threat triage EW-T reproduces the original exactly ( 8 / 8 8/8 against 0 / 8 0/8 with no skill) while EW-A fails. Over all 142 142 runs per arm: no skill 117 117 , original 134 134 , EW-T 130 130 , EW-A 125 125 strict passes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还为每个试点技能编写了一个任务（共 41 个任务，附带我们自己编写的提示词、验证器和参考解答），并运行了相同的 Haiku 智能体：每个分支中有 4 个任务各运行 8 次，37 个任务各运行 3 次。 由于验证器是我们自己编写的，这相比基准测试任务是一种较弱的检验。 在 36 个任务上，智能体无论有无技能都能通过，原始技能与两个重建版本的结果一致；还有两个任务在所有分支中均失败。 在技能起作用的三个任务上，原始技能在 19 次运行中通过 18 次，EW-T 通过 12 次，EW-A 通过 11 次，而无技能时仅通过 1 次；在威胁分级任务上，EW-T 完全复现了原始技能的结果（8/8，而无技能时为 0/8），而 EW-A 则失败了。 在每个分支全部 142 次运行中：无技能严格通过 117 次，原始技能 134 次，EW-T 130 次，EW-A 125 次。

paragraphs.en: For each skill, the base model writes about 60 60 requests and answers them with the document in its prompt; a rank- 16 16 LoRA is fitted to give those answers without the document. All 78 78 fitted adapters lowered held-out answer loss by at least 10 % 10\% (median 69 % 69\% ). 54 54 were used for training and the rest for testing, together with 4 4 skills made with the main paper’s recipe. EW-B is the Executing Writer of Section 4 , trained on 11 11 , 22 22 and 45 45 adapters. We compared it with training-free methods: generic and domain-targeted probes, vocabulary-lens words, amplified answers (sampling from log ⁡ p adapter + α ⁡ ( log ⁡ p adapter − log ⁡ p base ) \log p_{\text{adapter}}+\alpha(\log p_{\text{adapter}}-\log p_{\text{base}}) , α = 1 \alpha=1 ), best-of- n n sampling, self-report and retrieval. Metrics are judge-free: behavioural fidelity M1 is the share of the original document’s help to the likelihood of the prompted model’s answers that a candidate provides ( 1 1 for the original, 0 0 for none), and coverage counts the original’s units that have an embedding neighbour in the candidate (cosine ≥ 0.757 \geq 0.757 , calibrated on documents that restate each other).

paragraphs.en: The writer depends on the adapter: the correct adapter lowers validation loss by about 0.7 0.7 nats per token against a wrong one, against 0.001 0.001 for the soft-prompt writer of Table 4 . But it overfits within 30 30 of 120 120 steps and memorises its training documents. It has the best coverage on held-out skills ( 7.3 % 7.3\% , interval [ 2.4 , 13.5 ] [2.4,13.5] , against 1.2 % 1.2\% for a wrong adapter; sign test p = 0.36 p=0.36 , n = 8 n=8 ), far below the 20 % 20\% we had set as success, and 1.1 % 1.1\% on the paper-recipe adapters (Table 14 ). Its documents name the right area and miss the specifics (for an architecture-diagram skill: “AI Assistant for Code Review and Documentation”). Coverage rises from 0.0 % 0.0\% with 11 11 training adapters to 5.3 % 5.3\% with 45 45 , but only 2 2 to 14 14 documents were scored per size, so this is a direction, not a measurement. No training-free method beats the wrong-adapter control on coverage by more than 4 4 points; amplified answers are the exception on behavioural fidelity ( 0.19 0.19 against − 0.07 -0.07 , p = 0.011 p=0.011 , n = 10 n=10 ), so they carry some adapter-specific behaviour without stating its rules. paragraphs.en: To test reading on an adapter that was not built for this study, we used the docker_compose_gen LoRA that we had trained earlier for a separate project and released in the adaptive-minds-loras collection (rank 32 32 , Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct). Data: 200 200 test items over ten flag families ( 20 20 each), 100 100 development and 400 400 training items, all disjoint. A response is exact if its parsed YAML equals the reference; the soft score is a field-level F1. Writers here are Claude Sonnet agents with the arms of Appendix E , plus A-deep (at least 25 25 probes before the first score) and A+D-probe (at least 20 20 adapter probes before reading any example).

paragraphs.en: With no training data, after two to four probes of the adapter, the agent wrote skills that take the base model from 0.000 0.000 to 0.263 0.263 exact on average ( 0.235 0.235 – 0.300 0.300 ) and recover about 84 % 84\% of the LoRA’s soft gain. A skill from the wrong adapter and a skill from the task text alone both stay at 0.000 0.000 , because the reference follows conventions the base model cannot guess (a fixed project name, a null default network, a command list for tokens after the image). Probing harder did not help, but forcing probes before reading data gave the best skill ( 0.360 0.360 ). Twenty in-context examples ( 0.435 0.435 ) beat every skill, and the LoRA ( 0.595 0.595 ) beats everything; a good skill on top of the LoRA adds up to 0.095 0.095 , and a vague one costs up to 0.145 0.145 . Per flag family, adapter-only skills come close to the LoRA on logging ( 0.38 0.38 against 0.40 0.40 ) but recover little on numeric and structured fields (health checks 0.08 0.08 against 0.70 0.70 ). Renaming the service in 199 199 test items left the LoRA unchanged ( 0.593 0.593 ), so it had not memorised the test items. The one-session Haiku agent of Section 7 gave 0.212 0.212 with the real adapter and 0.000 0.000 with a wrong one.

paragraphs.en: Rule A holds if the game is won and the action just before the winning action is exactly inventory . Rule B holds if the game is won and the action right after the first successful take is exactly look . The original LoRA, the base model and the expert games score 0 % 0\% on both rules; the expert games with the rule step inserted score 100 % 100\% . LoRA-A and LoRA-B use the recipe of the ALFWorld LoRA with the loss on the inserted step weighted three times, and passed a pre-set gate after one epoch (development rule success 87.5 % 87.5\% and 70.0 % 70.0\% , base 0 % 0\% ). For the adapter arms the agent’s score is agreement with that adapter; no prompt, tool output or file the agent can read contains either rule.
paragraphs.zh: 若游戏获胜且获胜动作之前紧邻的动作恰好是 inventory，则规则 A 成立。 若游戏获胜且第一次成功 take 之后紧随的动作恰好是 look，则规则 B 成立。 原始 LoRA、基础模型以及专家游戏在两条规则上的得分均为 0 % 0\%；插入规则步骤后的专家游戏得分为 100 % 100\%。 LoRA-A 和 LoRA-B 使用 ALFWorld LoRA 的配方，并对插入步骤的损失加权三倍，在一个 epoch 后通过了预设门槛（开发规则成功率分别为 87.5 % 87.5\% 和 70.0 % 70.0\%，基础模型为 0 % 0\%）。 对于适配器分支，智能体的得分即与该适配器的一致性；智能体可读取的任何提示、工具输出或文件中都不包含这两条规则中的任何一条。

paragraphs.en: The weight lens takes the top singular directions of each LoRA update in the attention-output and MLP-down projections and reads them through the final norm and output embedding, with and without centring over the three ALFWorld LoRAs. For every LoRA, most ALFWorld command words reach rank 1 1 in some layer, direction and sign, so the best rank is not specific. The activation lens averages, over 200 200 development states, the difference between the adapted and base model’s last-token hidden state at each layer, subtracts the mean of this difference over the three LoRAs, and reads it through the output embedding.
paragraphs.zh: 权重透镜取每个 LoRA 更新在注意力输出投影和 MLP 下投影中的最顶奇异方向，并通过最终的归一化层和输出嵌入读取它们，对三个 ALFWorld LoRA 分别在中心化和不中心化两种情况下进行。 对于每个 LoRA，大多数 ALFWorld 命令词都能在某个层、方向和符号下达到秩 1 1，因此最佳秩并不具有特异性。 激活透镜在 200 200 个开发状态上取适配模型与基座模型在每一层的最后一个词元隐状态之差的平均值，减去该差值在三个 LoRA 上的均值，再通过输出嵌入读取。
